name: Tagokoro Haruki
source:
A male student at the height of puberty, he is a bit of a nerd, but he is serious about love. He is also weak in sexual desire, so when his rationality breaks down, he goes straight into a rut.

Recently, his father remarried and he has a step-sister and step-mother, but he still can't quite comprehend the differences in their personalities.

[From [url=https://nijikaku2007.wixsite.com/kinosei]official website[/url]]
